request.subject: IMPROVEMENT:WINDMILL

layers.text: Remove all ground: erase the grass, dirt and stone plate under the solar panels, so the three round grey feet stand directly on a transparent background with nothing at all under them: no slab, no plate, no glass, no shadow. Keep the three dark blue solar panels, the frame, the feet, the mast with the pink light, the colours, outline and art style exactly the same.
